widget_mechanic: Compound-interest / loan calculator has a frequency dropdown (Annually, Monthly, Quarterly, Daily). Default is Annually. Agent must change to match user's requested compounding period.

source_inspiration.instruction: go to investor.gov and compute how much money I will have with an initial principle of $10000, to which I make monthly contributions of $200 over 10 years. Assume an interest rate of 5.0 compounded quarterly. Additionally, tell me the colors of the lines it plots in the results.
